ShortDescription.Value: Real-world maps over the terrain as a tracing overlay, at 1:1 or a scale that matches your heightmap.

Publish.LongDescription:
Shows a real-world map over the terrain, like tracing paper, to lay out cities that follow real streets. It does not change your save.
- Search for a place, an address, coordinates or a Google Maps / OpenStreetMap link. - Move and rotate the map by dragging it on the ground, with the arrows or with fine rotation steps. - Map scale from 25% to 200%. Enter the Terraining map size to match a heightmap, and put the map centre on the city centre with one button. - Map styles: OpenStreetMap, Topographic (OpenTopoMap, with contour lines) or a custom tile URL with your own key. - Opacity, on top of everything or laid on the terrain, area size or the whole map.
Open it with the button at the top left of the game. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

ChangeLog.Value: 0.2.0 beta: drag tool, adjustable scale for heightmaps, map styles, new panel, safer whole-map loading.
